services.title: Applying for a slot in a relocation site
services.description: A slot in a city relocation or resettlement site, for informal settlers, people displaced by development, and those living in danger zones. You report to the office daily while your application is pending, and the office inspects the sites monthly once you are awarded a lot.
services.office: Office of Resettlement, Housing and Community Development
services.whoMayAvail: Underprivileged and homeless citizens and informal settlers

requirements.item: Application form, 1 original
requirements.whereToSecure: Office of Resettlement, Housing and Community Development

requirements.item: Barangay certificate of residency
Community tax certificate (cedula) for the current year
Copy of the voter's affidavit or voter's ID
Latest income tax return, or in its absence an affidavit of income
Affidavit that you do not own any real property in the Philippines, or a certification of non-ownership of land
Photocopy of the marriage contract if married, or the birth certificate if single
Four 2x2 pictures
One folder and fastener

steps.client: Write a letter to the City Mayor asking for a slot in the relocation or resettlement site.
steps.agency: Helps you write the letter to the City Mayor and submits it to the City Mayor's Office.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Aide I and job order staff

steps.client: Sit the interview and receive your batch number.
steps.agency: Interviews you, assigns a batch number, and requires you to follow up daily by reporting to the office in person and signing the attendance sheet.
steps.personResponsible: Job order staff

steps.client: Submit the required documents and receive the award of your lot.
steps.agency: Awards the lot to qualified beneficiaries once the required documents are in.
steps.personResponsible: Acting CGDH I

steps.agency: Conducts monthly monitoring and site inspection of the actual occupants in the relocation and resettlement sites.
steps.personResponsible: Acting CGDH I

steps.agency: Confiscates the slot from beneficiaries found to have violated the terms and conditions of occupancy.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Aides I and IV

notes: You have to report to the office in person every day while your application is pending and sign the attendance sheet.
A slot can be taken back if the terms and conditions of occupancy are broken.

services.title: Buying a city-owned lot through socialized housing
services.description: Acquisition, appraisal and disposition of land the city owns or has acquired. Lots offered through socialized housing are paid on an instalment scheme against a value set by the Appraisal Committee, and you get a certification of full payment at the end.
services.office: Office of Resettlement, Housing and Community Development
services.whoMayAvail: Underprivileged and homeless citizens and informal settlers

requirements.item: Application form, 1 original
requirements.whereToSecure: Office of Resettlement, Housing and Community Development

requirements.item: Barangay certificate of residency
Community tax certificate (cedula) for the current year
Copy of the voter's affidavit or voter's ID
Latest income tax return, or in its absence an affidavit of income
Affidavit that you do not own any real property in the Philippines, or a certification of non-ownership of land
Photocopy of the marriage contract if married, or the birth certificate if single
Four 2x2 pictures
One folder and fastener

steps.client: File your application for verification and assessment.
steps.agency: Processes the documentary requirements of applicants for the city-owned or acquired properties.
steps.personResponsible: Acting CGDH I / Administrative Aide IV

steps.client: Pay against the schedule of payments.
steps.agency: Prepares the schedule of payments of the appraised value set by the Appraisal Committee for lots offered for sale through socialized housing on an instalment scheme, and the corresponding penalties for anything past due. Payment is collected by the City Treasurer's Office.
steps.feeText: The appraised value set by the Appraisal Committee, on an instalment scheme, plus penalties for past due amounts
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Aide I / Administrative Aide VI

steps.client: Receive the certification of full payment.
steps.agency: Prepares, issues and countersigns the certification of full payment for the city-owned or acquired property, to be signed by the City Treasurer and the City Mayor.
steps.personResponsible: Acting CGDH I / Administrative Aide I

notes: What you pay is the appraised value the Appraisal Committee sets for the lot, not a fixed fee, and it is paid in instalments.
